title: Paloma Rewards Benefit: Extra Days on a Reactivated Cash Pickup
content:
**Programme note.** Paloma Rewards members receive extra collection days when an expired Cash Pickup pickup is reactivated. The days follow the tier of the sender's Paloma Rewards membership whose status is active.

| Sender's active Paloma Rewards tier | Days added to the reactivated window |
|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Gold, Paloma Rewards Platinum, Paloma Rewards Diamond, Paloma Rewards Elite | 4 |
| Paloma Rewards Blue, Paloma Rewards Silver | 2 |
| no active membership | none |

The days are whole calendar days, and they move the reactivated pickup's last day of collection later. A membership that is not active gives none.

Hypothetical members: an active Paloma Rewards Gold member receives 4 days. An active Paloma Rewards Blue member receives 2.
